topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When my neighbor approached me about using a portion of my yard for a garden, the request hung in the air, heavy with an unforeseen twist. I've always kept to myself, my yard a solitary extension of my space. The idea of ceding any ground, even for verdant pursuits, felt intrusive. Yet, there was something in his earnest plea, the promise of shared tomatoes and perhaps a less solitary existence, that made the ground beneath my feet feel a little less firm. I found myself nodding, the words leaving my mouth before a more guarded part of me could intervene. "Alright, but just a corner," I said, the weight of the decision settling around me.
